_meta.hard_rule: A fix is 'fixed' ONLY when its full business-chain spec passes end-to-end - never an isolated probe. (B1, 2026-06-09, was falsely declared fixed off a single-insert probe; only the full return->credit->statement->unapply chain exposed the stacked breaks.)
_meta.pass_signal: Every chain is a single DO block that ALWAYS terminates with RAISE EXCEPTION 'SMOKE_PASS_ROLLBACK'. That exact error text = PASS (and guarantees rollback). ANY other error = FAIL.
_meta.spec_contract: Keys are the primary RPC under test. 'covers' lists every RPC the chain exercises - run-smoke.mjs --spec <rpc> matches keys AND covers entries, so one chain can certify several RPCs. Every migration that touches an RPC must have or extend a spec covering it.
_meta.area_tags: Every spec carries an "area" array (business-area tags: billing, inventory, lifecycle, pricing, security, idempotency, regression). run-smoke.mjs --area <area> selects by tag; scripts/run-area.mjs bundles these with the matching vitest slice and DB invariant sweeps.

create_order_from_blend_ticket.description: CONTAINER ONLY - run via scripts/smoke/prove-blend-ticket-fractional-cents.mjs, never through run-smoke.mjs against the live database: the chain INSERTs a customer, blend ticket and order, which the LIVE-DATA GUARD correctly refuses. CRX-MONEY-001 (fixed live by 20260811200000, ledger 20260811220045): create_order_from_blend_ticket finished by overwriting the orders header from raw unrounded price x converted-quantity sums, so any blend ticket whose quantity produced a sub-cent line value violated orders_total_cost_whole_cents_chk / orders_total_profit_whole_cents_chk and rolled back the entire completed-ticket-to-order transaction. Latent, never hit in production - no blend ticket has ever produced an order. The prover reads the PRE-FIX body from 20260714230200 and the POST-FIX body from 20260811200000, refusing to run unless the post-fix md5 still equals a pinned snapshot of production pg_proc taken 2026-08-11 - a historical reading, not a live one, since the container has no network, so it catches the repo drifting off what was applied rather than production changing underneath. Six stages: A the pre-fix body violates the whole-cent CHECK; B the migration applies verbatim and its own $ postcondition passes; C the fixed body books whole-cent totals equal to the canonical sum-of-rounded-lines, reports back what it stored, links the ticket, replays idempotently and keeps SECURITY DEFINER, a pinned search_path and no anon/PUBLIC EXECUTE; D re-applying with after_order_items_change dropped FAILS CLOSED; E re-applying with that trigger set REPLICA-only also FAILS CLOSED, which the widespread tgenabled <> 'D' idiom would not catch; F characterizes the one residual gap - the trigger guarantee is APPLY-time only, so with the fixed body and the trigger dropped at RUN time the RPC reports success and books a zero-value header. Ends in SMOKE_PASS_ROLLBACK at stage C. Every helper body in the fixture is md5-verified against live pg_proc EXCEPT link_blend_ticket_to_order, which is a deliberate behavior-equivalent stand-in (live is 8.3 KB across tables the fixture trims) - it is therefore NOT listed in covers; real coverage for it lives in the create_blend_ticket chain.

assign_customers_sales_rep.description: Customer 360 ownership assignment chain: no-auth and non-admin callers are rejected; a non-sales-rep target is rejected; one real plus one missing customer raises ASSIGNMENT_CUSTOMER_SET_CHANGED and proves the real row stayed unchanged; an admin atomically assigns two active customers to an active sales rep and writes exactly one customer-scoped activity row per assignment; reversed-order exact replay returns the identical result without duplicating activity; and changed-payload key reuse fails closed. All customer, activity, and idempotency rows roll back on SMOKE_PASS_ROLLBACK.

complete_team_note.description: Team Board delegation chain (migrations 20260809130108 + 20260810010308): INSERT-with-assignee fires exactly one task_assigned notification; a rollback-only synthetic inactive auth/profile fixture proves inactive actors are rejected and inactive assignees stay silent without touching a real teammate's auth state; no-auth and anon calls raise AUTH_REQUIRED; an authenticated outsider (not creator/assignee/admin) is rejected; the non-admin ASSIGNEE completes a note they did not create with completed_by stamped from auth.uid(); exact idempotent replay returns the saved result without double activity logging; same-key different-payload raises COMPLETE_REPLAY_PAYLOAD_MISMATCH; the creator reopens; reassignment notifies only the new assignee; self-assignment and unchanged-assignee updates stay silent; a soft-deleted note raises NOTE_NOT_FOUND; anon EXECUTE is denied on the RPC and client roles cannot EXECUTE the trigger function. Terminal rollback.

pending_commission_snapshot_reconcile.description: Post-apply read-only invariant for the forward-only stale-profit follow-up: every eligible pending, non-deleted, unbatched order-channel commission matches the canonical order header and compute_commission_amount result; paid/cancelled/deleted/batched and job/application commissions remain outside the repair boundary. Terminal rollback marker.

historical_ar_report_cutoffs.description: Section 2 historical AR report proof: an overdue invoice remains visible in both AR Aging and Customer Balance Listing, a fully paid invoice remains in cumulative invoiced/paid/count totals without entering open balance, a future-dated invoice is excluded, a post-cutoff credit application is replayed to the exact gross/open-credit cutoff, later prepay activity fails closed, and anonymous/private-helper grants remain denied. Self-contained fixtures and terminal rollback.

save_quote_customer_row_version.description: LOCAL ONLY pending-apply rollback fixture: executes the real save_quote/save_customer contracts for exact +1 tokens, payload-bound/current-token-verified idempotent replay, draft->sent->sent lifecycle persistence, stale header/child/address rejection, concurrent Customer money-path invalidation, split-conflict precedence, auth/role gates, sales-rep non-owner Customer rejection, and sales-rep non-owner Quote save, replay, version, and conversion rejection before mutation or result release, plus server-authoritative quote item math. As an authenticated browser role it proves stable parent-version reads while direct child INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE are denied; SECURITY DEFINER parent saves still replace child collections. The companion network-isolated PostgreSQL 17 prover demonstrates the pre-fix overwrite, both lock orders, payload-conflict and advanced-token replay rejection, exact split-conflict < stale-token < lifecycle/unplan < write ordering, mutation-resistant ownership gates, and normalized canonical-body preservation outside the audited row-version/security delta. Run smoke-planned-holds-drawn-sync.sql alongside this chain for planned-hold preservation; no PASS is a live-apply claim.

save_field.description: save_field actor-binding rollback proof: no-auth and forged actors fail before field writes, a legacy NULL actor is bound to the authenticated admin, request replay returns the same field without duplicate activity, and the sole SECURITY DEFINER overload retains its fixed search_path and narrow grants.

supplier_pricing_phase3_return_policy.description: Supplier Pricing Phase 3 Stage A rollback matrix: dormant unknown/default Product compatibility; full returnable create/approve/receive/restock/credit lifecycle; governed metadata refusal at requested/approved/received; exact no-return create/re-credit and direct return-items refusals; received cancellation inventory reversal; linked and unrelated-credit-memo unapply boundaries; reject/cancel/unapply reversal boundaries; and forced late-failure atomic rollback for requested, approved, received/restock, credit-issued, rejected, cancelled, and credit-memo-unapplied effects. The companion prove-supplier-pricing-phase3-return-policy-concurrency.mjs proves autocommit and explicit deferred-FK timing plus two independent-session sorted advisory-lock races for wrappers, direct return_items writes, unapply, and a regression-sensitive received-cancel versus approved-receive race on the same Product/inventory row.

section9_po_ap_high_remediation.description: Section 9 PO/AP HIGH closeout: real save/submit/edit/alternate-location receive/reverse/cancel paths keep Main Warehouse on-order equal to authoritative open remainder; vendor and accounting-period browser mutation grants/policies are absent; cancelled-PO bill creation and billed-PO cancellation fail in the shared PO-first lock contract; AP and receiving mutations replay only the same actor plus exact payload; AP aging uses due-date Current/1-30/31-60/61-90/over-90 boundaries and fails closed for unsupported dates; Due This Month ends at Chicago calendar month-end; a real close_accounting_period call makes update_vendor_bill, record_vendor_payment, void_vendor_payment, and void_vendor_bill reject closed-period history without side effects. Self-contained fixtures and terminal rollback. Companion isolated-PostgreSQL provers cover PO/AP and accounting-period concurrency in both winning orders.

money_lifecycle_idempotency_required.description: Public money/lifecycle boundary: create_invoice_from_order, create_invoice_for_unbilled_delivery, post_invoice, cancel_order, generate_finance_charges, and batch_post_invoices all reject NULL or all-whitespace idempotency keys before mutation; actor-bearing wrappers reject forgery; batch posting derives a nonblank child key; and a valid finance-charge key creates one completed replay record and replays exactly. Terminal rollback.

govern_invoice_order_money_lifecycle.description: Invoice/order lifecycle closeout: binds invoice creation/posting/cancellation retries, preserves completed-delivery recovery, closes only the undelivered remainder of partially fulfilled orders, locks customer/product source lineage, blocks terminal-order invoice rewrites and direct invoice DML, filters reversed transaction history, and proves every rejected path leaves its money/inventory lineage unchanged. Self-contained fixtures and terminal rollback.

delivery_signature_storage_access.description: Delivery-signature Storage access is private and scoped to the delivery path and authorized actor; the shared sales-rep helper is proven immune to a forged pg_temp profiles table.

supplier_pricing_phase1b.description: Supplier Pricing Phase 1b full chain: every mutator passes no-auth, anon, wrong-role, forged-actor, positive-control, and idempotent-replay probes; a reviewed vendor alias feeds a reusable comparable supplier link, a one-row quick quote stages and approves into append-only evidence, all five read RPCs return the linked/imported evidence, pack conversion identifies the correct cheapest normalized cost, and a correction supersedes rather than rewrites the original observation. Payload mismatch, link/history immutability, observation immutability, and zero Product cost/sell-price changes are asserted. Self-contained synthetic evidence with terminal rollback.

supplier_cost_basis_phase2_live.description: Supplier cost-basis Phase 2 live rollback proof: verifies the default-off gate and direct-ledger/RPC isolation, then creates two transaction-scoped Products. It proves the governed Product-page and server-generated monthly-workbook routes each preview and apply exact cents, replay the same idempotency key without changing the response or creating duplicate history/basis rows, and consumes the workbook export. No fixture IDs, cardinality assumptions, or temporary-file payload are required.

financial_scope_and_delivery_aggregate.description: Security and inventory aggregate chain: an active sales rep creates and replays a draft invoice and reads a statement for their assigned customer, but cannot edit or replay an unassigned customer's invoice, cannot hijack it by requesting reassignment to an assigned customer, and cannot read that customer's statement; inactive access is denied. A real delivery with two individually in-stock lines for one product but an aggregate shortage completes under WARN-NOT-BLOCK, returns and caches one warning, marks both append-only delivered ledger rows for review at insertion, emits one activity/notification set, and replays without duplicating warnings. Self-contained fixtures and terminal rollback.

adversarial_money_inventory_closeout.description: Adversarial money/inventory closeout chain: invoice save and post replays remain bound to the authorized customer; invalid PO lines are rejected; one global bulk-import intent returns the original PO across authorized employees; an admin delete clears its durable claim and all cached save results so the unchanged document and deterministic key create a fresh PO; omitted edit costs remain penny-exact; duplicate or foreign PO line IDs are rejected; and all disposable fixtures roll back at the terminal pass signal.

enforce_delivery_accounting_period.description: Delivery closed-period, rewrite, and replay-authorization invariant: the real complete_delivery RPC rejects a closed business date during its side-effect-free outer preflight; an open-date completion succeeds; a different active but unauthorized user is denied before its committed result can replay; authenticated direct rewrites cannot move completed history or legacy scheduled-date-backed terminal history into or out of a closed period; the real admin void_delivery RPC rejects once the completion date is closed without leaking a reversal; reopening the disposable period permits the normal void path. Self-contained fixtures and terminal rollback.

create_blend_ticket.description: Full-gauntlet remediation chain: serialized idempotency plus real helper/legacy races; commission rejection and valid post/replay/audit; inactive/nonfinite/over-receiving guards; atomic manual/OCR creation; optimistic-version ticket save success, exact replay, missing-version rejection, processing rejection, and stale-edit rejection before and after OCR; atomic OCR commit success, field/manual-product preservation, queue completion, invalid/stale/lifecycle rollback, deleted-ticket denial, and replay; exact blend-line mapping and missing-inventory upsert; linked/billed/applied lifecycle, header, product, field, reparent, and soft-delete locks; forged versus direct-invoice billing provenance; active-invoice link/create-order rejection with zero side effects; linked-order and stale-active-invoice direct-billing rejection with zero invoice/commission/idempotency/log effects; cancelled/voided reset; billed/invoice/application/valid unlink paths; RPC-only legal application snapshots; owner/uploader versus cross-sales Storage mutation boundaries; final RLS/Storage commands, grants, and bucket limits. prove-gauntlet-idempotency-concurrency.mjs additionally runs real two-session idempotency, link/product/reparent, approval/OCR, link/OCR, and lease/OCR races in a network-isolated disposable PostgreSQL container. Terminal rollback.

remaining_money_inventory_hardening.description: Final money/inventory audit chain: voided orders disappear from detail, summary, gross-sales, and finance-dashboard revenue; inactive sales/admin profiles are rejected; only an active admin can use the PO over-receive flag, NULL cannot bypass the quantity ceiling, and a real admin 11-against-10 receipt succeeds; anonymous gross-sales execution and authenticated direct payment-table writes are absent. Self-contained fixtures and terminal rollback.

save_purchase_order.description: Purchase-order lifecycle and cents correction: fractional-cent costs are rejected; an active sales rep cannot create a submitted PO through save_purchase_order, creates and idempotently replays a draft with a fractional quantity and penny-exact integer-cent header and line costs, edits it while preserving an omitted existing-line cost in both the line and header, cannot transition status through ordinary save, submits through the dedicated idempotent submit_purchase_order RPC, cannot downgrade the submitted PO through save, and cancels it through the dedicated idempotent cancel_purchase_order RPC. An active non-office user is denied. Self-contained fixture and terminal rollback.

gauntlet_money_workflows.description: Money-workflow correction chain: get_ap_dashboard_summary excludes a voided vendor payment while counting an active one; preview_finance_charges and generate_finance_charges share the same overdue balance and penny-exact charge, reject future dates without side effects, and generate/replay one unposted charge invoice; create_prepay_check_splits rejects a mismatched independent check total without side effects, then creates and idempotently replays two exact prepay buckets. Self-contained fixtures and terminal rollback.

apply_prepay_to_invoice.description: H1 role-gate regression: apply_prepay_to_invoice rejects a deactivated but still-authenticated actor. Self-contained fixtures and terminal rollback.

revert_quote_status.description: B2 escape-hatch regression: a quote stranded at 'accepted' after its whole-conversion order was cancelled must be rescuable. Converts a whole quote, cancels the order (quote stays 'accepted', draws still fully drawn), then asserts revert_quote_status reopens it to 'sent', releases the draw ledger, and a re-convert creates a NEW order. FAIL-FIRST against the pre-fix function (revert refused because an order existed). Self-contained fixtures and terminal rollback.

generate_finance_charges.description: H2 double-charge and preview-parity regression: preview and generation both reject a closed accounting period, generation charges an overdue balance at most once per customer per calendar month, and preview omits a customer generation will skip. Exact request replay returns the original result, while reusing its key with a changed customer selection fails closed. The chain then voids the first charge invoice and proves preview plus generation permit exactly one corrected active assessment in the same month. FAIL-FIRST against the exact-date generator, unbound idempotency, either stale preview predicate, or bucket-only dedup that counts voided charge invoices. Self-contained fixtures and terminal rollback.

void_invoice.description: H3 cash-strand regression: void_invoice refuses an invoice with a supported allocation, void_payment reverses it, and only then can the invoice void; a prepay-only invoice still voids and re-banks correctly. Self-contained fixtures and terminal rollback.

restore_cancelled_order.description: H4 regression: restore_cancelled_order must refuse to reactivate a cancelled order (it cannot re-apply the released inventory / zeroed commissions / reversed draws, so a restored order would be corrupt). Converts a quote, cancels the order, then asserts restore raises ORDER_RESTORE_NOT_SUPPORTED and the order stays cancelled. FAIL-FIRST against the pre-fix function (restore succeeded, restoring a corrupt order). Self-contained fixtures and terminal rollback.

create_invoice_for_unbilled_delivery.description: H5 regression: mono backfill and posting refuse split-billing conflicts under both serialized writer orderings; private exact provenance cannot be forged; generic edits and singular voids of governed members are refused; void_invoice_group retires the whole group atomically with exact replay binding; and delete/cancel lifecycle paths remain governed. The companion disposable proof runs real two-session OIFA-vs-create and cancel-vs-revert interleavings. Self-contained fixtures and terminal rollback.

record_invoice_payment.description: Legacy-payment retirement regression: record_invoice_payment must reject new writes with LEGACY_PAYMENT_PATH_DISABLED and leave both the obsolete payments ledger and invoice paid amount unchanged. New cash uses allocate_payment so it has a supported void path. Self-contained fixtures and terminal rollback.

stage_offline_action.description: Permanent offline receipt chain: complete_delivery and complete_job stage -> immutable canonical replay -> canonical process -> durable sanitized status -> replay without duplicate inventory/application work; actor-bound processing; owner and office status visibility; missing-target and unauthorized-action retention; deterministic state-conflict review; sanitized office queue; audited, idempotent manual resolution; RPC-only writes; grants. Self-contained fixtures and terminal rollback.

set_field_boundary.description: Field-acre-billing acreage RPCs (migrations 20260623120000/130000): a ~40-ac polygon measures sane geodesic acres (acres_source='measured'); the 0.1-5000 band rejects oversize (AREA_OUT_OF_BAND); a typed override SURVIVES a redraw (set_field_boundary never touches override_acres); idempotent replay returns the same result; the fields_acre_authority trigger blocks a direct measured_acres write.

save_job.description: Field-app parity #1 (migration 20260624120000): the extended save_job round-trips scheduling dates (call/proposed/schedule/expires + time_proposed), consultant, three memo fields, per-field agronomy (planted_acres/crop/strip/pests), per-field customer shares, and chemical extras (diluent_rate/rei_hours/phi_days/warehouse/vendor); remaining_acres GENERATED = total - applied; field shares not totalling 100 raise SHARE_NOT_100; idempotent replay returns the same job_id with no second job; a forged p_performed_by raises ACTOR_MISMATCH. Steps 3b and 7 additionally cover migration 20260820120000 (chemical-unit invariant + derived money totals), which was APPLIED LIVE 2026-08-25 as ledger version 20260825142708. Those steps are FAIL-CLOSED, not gated: a save_job body without CHEM_UNIT_MISMATCH is a hard failure, because after the apply its absence is a regression rather than a pre-apply state. They assert the derived totals and that a pint-quantity-priced-per-gallon line and a per-cwt rate are both refused leaving no row behind. PREREQUISITE: this chain now requires BOTH 20260624120000 and 20260820120000; run it against a restored or staging database only after 20260820120000 is applied there, or it will fail by design. Chem A's quantity was corrected from 240 to 30 on 2026-08-23 -- it had been 240 pints recorded as 240 gallons, an 8x over-bill living in the parity fixture itself. NOTE: this spec is NOT container_only (the SQL chain above runs normally), and run-smoke.mjs only EXECUTES a container_prover on the container-only skip path -- it merely checks that the file exists. So prove-save-job-chem-unit-invariant.mjs is a MANUAL proof: --all and --area will not run it. Run it by hand after any change to migration 20260820120000 or its fixtures: node scripts/smoke/prove-save-job-chem-unit-invariant.mjs

save_job_field_acres_candidate.description: CONTAINER-ONLY candidate proof for 20260904185900. Run npm run proof:save-job-field-acres; never run this write-seeding fixture against live. The full-chain prover first requires the permanent save_job parity chain to pass against F06, then proves F06 accepts a missing acreage key, applies the exact candidate, reruns permanent parity, and requires focused A1-A4 coverage. A1/A2 refuse missing-key and JSON-null acreage with distinct JOB_ACRES_NOT_FINITE messages, A3 proves NEW direct-RPC blank-to-zero compatibility, and A4 refuses PostgreSQL numeric Infinity. Static postflight, eleven apply-abort mutants (including deletion of either acreage guard), and four runtime canaries prove placement and non-vacuity. The permanent save_job registry entry remains live-runnable and still points to the separate 66-behaviour-test prove-save-job-chem-unit-invariant.mjs manual proof.

save_quote.description: Drawn-product edit guard (A4): reducing a booking below its drawn quantity and removing a drawn product both raise BOOKING_OVERDRAWN; a legal reduce keeps booked/drawn/status consistent and the booking still closes at the new total; a no-draws control quote edits freely.

quote_commission_split_validation.description: Quote commission money-routing guard: blank or duplicate recipients and missing/JSON-null percentages fail closed on direct INSERT/UPDATE, while an explicit empty no-commission split and a complete named 100% split remain valid. Self-contained fixture and terminal rollback.

rollover_quote_to_season.description: Remainder-only season rollover (A5): 500-booked/200-drawn rolls over exactly 300 with FIFO consumption across split items and acre proration; fully-drawn raises BOOKING_FULLY_DRAWN; no-draws rollover preserves live copy behavior (total_units_needed stays NULL).

auto_expire_quotes.description: Expiry sweep skips partially-drawn bookings past expires_at, still expires an undrawn control quote, completes despite the best-effort activity_feed summary, and re-asserts the 20260609203541 grant hardening (no authenticated/anon EXECUTE).

void_order.description: Draw-ledger reversal on void/cancel: voiding a partial draw order restores the booking balance (re-draw works); cancelling a draw order restores the ledger but preserves the open booking's active hold (F7 skip); voiding the FINAL draw reopens an accepted booking ('booking_reopened' activity) and re-draw re-accepts; whole-conversion void leaves the booking closed; double-void/re-cancel guards hold.

issue_return_credit.description: THE canonical return->credit chain: direct return writes are denied; all six return RPC receipts bind actor plus exact return/create payload with exact replay and changed-actor/target/payload refusal; source-derived create -> approve/reject/cancel/receive -> issue credit -> statement single-count -> unapply/re-issue; paid, overdue, and posted source invoices all fund COGS reversal, noncontiguous repeated-cost source lots remain chronological instead of collapsing by cost, and uninvoiced returned quantity stays zero-cost; invoice-basis PNL and monthly summary retain all three recognized statuses; Apply Credit lost-response retry creates one application; explicit reversal and memo unapply immediately restore a past-due target to overdue; only the exact verified production source-free RMA remains finishable.

cancel_return.description: Return cancellation lifecycle chain: create_return -> approve_return -> receive_return, then active soft-delete and hard-delete are rejected, NULL/forged cancel actors are rejected without mutation, cancel_return reverses received inventory, stamps cancellation/activity/reversal attribution, clears restocked flags, and idempotent replay creates no duplicate reversal.

batch_apply_prepayments.description: Batch-prepay boundary: active non-admin denied, forged actor denied, active admin positive control succeeds, replay is stable, blank idempotency keys are rejected by both shared helpers, and the shared transaction advisory lock is present.

complete_cycle_count.description: Cycle-count complete/reverse chain: quantity changes 100->112->100, both replays are stable, lifecycle states advance correctly, and both wrappers retain inventory row locks.

update_order_items.description: Draw-order item lock (Codex r2 HIGH): editing items on a booking_draw order raises BOOKING_DRAW_ORDER_LOCKED (qty change AND add-item) with order+ledger intact, the remaining balance still draws to closure, and a whole-conversion control order (booking_draw=false) edits freely.

restore_quote_version.description: CONTAINER ONLY pending-apply post-tier-split restore guard: once a draw stamps per-line billing provenance, every version restore fails closed with QUOTE_RESTORE_BLOCKED_BY_DRAW before child replacement. The rollback smoke covers fall-below, removes-product, and quantity-safe snapshots; proves the quote remains usable to draw to closure; cancels both draw orders; requires the ledger to return to zero, the quote to reopen, and stamped audit rows to remain for each cancelled order; then pins the accepted post-cancellation refusal. Run only through prove-draw-down-quote-intent-binding.mjs after the pending cutover sequence; live still has the earlier restore behavior. The row-version matrix separately proves owner-only access, stale-writer rejection before child replacement, exact N+1 success, and request-bound replay. A no-draws control quote still restores freely.

create_quote_version.description: CRX-SEC-1 write boundary (migration 20260813080000): quote_versions.snapshot_data is an authoritative cost source since 20260812115236 - restore stamps quote_items.cost_at_quote_cents from snapshot_data.sections[].items[].current_cost, convert_quote_to_order copies it into the immutable order cost snapshot, and profit and commissions derive from there - so a direct table write is a commission-money write, and the below-cost trigger cannot catch it because understating the cost basis only raises apparent margin. Step 0 refuses to run until the boundary exists: it asserts anon and authenticated hold no table-level INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/TRUNCATE/TRIGGER/REFERENCES and no column-level INSERT/UPDATE/REFERENCES, which is both a safety gate (steps 1-4 are real write statements, and pre-fix the TRUNCATE would take an ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock on a live money table) and the direct grant-level assertion, since an RLS WITH CHECK violation also raises 42501. Under a real admin JWT - the case the dropped is_admin() policy WOULD have allowed - a direct forged-cost INSERT, an UPDATE, a DELETE and a TRUNCATE must each raise insufficient_privilege, the row count must not move, and then the legitimate path must still work: create_quote_version succeeds and authenticated SELECT still renders version history, so the boundary cannot be satisfied by breaking version creation. Ends in SMOKE_PASS_ROLLBACK; the RPC-created version row rolls back. EXPECT SMOKE_PREREQ, not a pass, on any database where 20260813080000 has not applied.

get_customer_statement.description: Statement blind-spot fix (CHIP task_25d25699, migrations 20260611131549 + 20260716160000): legacy, NULL-order, and allocation-set payments each appear exactly once; paid/overdue invoices keep their charge lines; soft-deleted payments excluded; credit memo single-count; unapplied overpayment prepay NOT pre-counted (DEDUP RULE); the exact same allocate_payment key is replayed after the committed result and must return the cached result without a second allocation set or statement change (regression proof for the atomic idempotency-claim guard); running balance never negative; unknown-actor auth probe rejected by the in-body gate.

get_detailed_statement_data.description: Detailed and batch statement consistency: an overdue-only synthetic customer is included in the month-end batch; a finance-charge invoice exposes linked charge metadata without adding it twice to net_due_cents; gross open invoices, unapplied credit memos, and net account position reconcile exactly; forged actors and a non-admin empty-result probe raise their exact authorization errors. Synthetic fixtures and candidate function replacements roll back.

statement_opening_balance.description: Bounded customer statement regression: pre-period AR is carried as an opening-balance row, same-day invoices have stable UUID ordering with a ROWS running frame, the ending balance equals full as-of AR, and reversed date ranges fail closed.

create_planned_holds.description: CONTAINER ONLY pending-apply planned-hold/post-tier-split restore chain: active holds always equal booked − drawn per product after create_planned_holds and save_quote (Draft/Revise/Present), with FIFO consumption so per-item expiry (needed_by+14d) follows the still-reserved tail; rebuild-after-draw no longer re-reserves drawn quantity. A drawn booking's post-cutover restore_quote_version refusal is pinned to QUOTE_RESTORE_BLOCKED_BY_DRAW and leaves synchronized holds unchanged; is_planned switched off + save releases all holds server-side. Run only through prove-draw-down-quote-intent-binding.mjs after the pending cutover sequence; live still has the earlier restore behavior.

draw_down_quote_intent_binding.description: CONTAINER ONLY pending-apply rollback proof for 20260819232000 after 20260816110000, 20260816120000 and 20260817120000: an active sales rep successfully covers a colleague's live booking through the real tier-split money/inventory path; numeric-equivalent exact replay returns one saved order; changed quantity and changed actor fail closed; the receipt is bound to actor plus fingerprint; line/header price, cost and profit remain exact; one exact $5 commission is written to the intended rep; inventory is prebooked once; and a deleted quote is hidden before replay. The network-isolated PostgreSQL 17 prover first applies 20260819232000 verbatim over exact reviewed helper/wrapper/pricing/lifecycle prerequisites, then uses an effect-recording stand-in for adversarial wrapper schedules covering admin/rep authorization, auth/role refusals, required-key plus keyed empty/non-numeric/non-finite guards, ACLs, same-key races, stale-replay mutation, helper/wrapper/prerequisite-body drift, overload drift, autocommit refusal, REPEATABLE READ stale-snapshot refusal and an in-flight legacy receipt drained by the exclusive cutover lock before refusal. A second database restores baseline 20260727174805, surfaces the one-shot quarantine notice, replays every default replay-eligible ledger-selected migration through this candidate, and executes this chain against the real money/commission/inventory/draw-ledger implementation to SMOKE_PASS_ROLLBACK. No PASS is a live-apply claim.

draw_down_quote.description: Standard 4-probe auth set, worked example against draw_down_quote: no-auth -> AUTH_REQUIRED; anon-key -> AUTH_REQUIRED with zero rows written; wrong-role (driver/applicator) -> INSUFFICIENT_ROLE; forged p_performed_by -> ACTOR_MISMATCH; plus a positive admin control draw proving the probes failed for the right reason. File header documents the placeholders for adapting it to any new RPC.

bulk_import_order.description: Section 4 lifecycle parity: rejects partial/terminal statuses and non-finite numbers; creates confirmed orders only; snapshots Product-authoritative cost; keeps line profit whole-cent and reconciled to canonical order profit; recomputes totals server-side; atomically prebooks inventory, writes the booked ledger, creates commissions and activity; returns canonical Net Position warnings; and proves actor/payload-bound replay plus changed-intent rejection. Synthetic fixtures always terminate with SMOKE_PASS_ROLLBACK.

create_direct_order.description: Customer-PO param (migration 20260614130000): a REAL active sales_rep creates a direct order WITH p_customer_po_number and the PO persists on orders (the bug: the old frontend post-create orders.update() hit the admin-only orders_update RLS and failed for sales_rep). Asserts order/order_items/inventory-prebook created, status confirmed; whitespace PO normalizes to NULL; idempotency replay returns the same order with no duplicate; plus the auth probes (no-auth -> Authentication required, driver -> INSUFFICIENT_ROLE, forged actor -> Actor mismatch).

load_recipe_into_job.description: Recipe per-unit pricing BUNDLE (Phase 4, REQUIRES 20260618230000 + 20260619150000): save_blend_recipe persists price_per_unit_cents on create AND keeps it on edit (no wipe — Codex Phase-4 P2); load_recipe_into_job seeds job_chemicals.price_per_unit_cents from it; a negative price is rejected. Pre-apply the chain FAILS (live save_blend_recipe drops the column).

save_field_app_invoice.description: Field-app parity and save/post serialization: a multi-customer field auto-splits into ONE invoice PER billing customer sharing an invoice_group_id; the split is PENNY-EXACT on an INDIVISIBLE total (price 1501c, rate 0.01, 1/3-2/3 split -> A=500c + B=1001c = 1501c odd); invoice_shares and acres tie exactly; an idempotent retry creates no duplicate; save/group-post serialize on the immutable group ID before ordered row locking; and a save after real group posting is rejected before invoice lines can change.

save_invoice.description: save_invoice field-application aware (#3 edit-path, REQUIRES 20260619160000): editing a field_application invoice PRESERVES the is_application_fee machine-fee line + re-balances the per-grower invoice_shares to the new total; a chemical_sale invoice's shares are NOT touched (field-only guard). Pre-apply the chain FAILS (live save_invoice drops the fee flag + never touches shares).

fuel_surcharge.description: Field-app parity #32 (REQUIRES 20260625140000): fuel surcharge is OFF by default and inert. Proves: with app_settings.fuel_surcharge at the shipped default (enabled=false, rate blank) a saved field-app invoice has NO 'Fuel Surcharge' line and the total is the pure pre-surcharge sum (DEFAULT-OFF INERT); after an admin sets enabled=true + a TEST per-acre rate, a re-save adds EXACTLY ONE is_application_fee 'Fuel Surcharge' line of ROUND(rate*100*acres) cents and the total rises by EXACTLY that amount (no drift); the surcharge flows into invoice_shares.amount_cents (share split / print); and enabled+BLANK rate produces NO line (off-if-formula-blank). The config writes are inside the rolled-back txn so the persisted OFF default is never changed. NEVER invents a rate.

transfer_job_to_invoice.description: Job->field-invoice billing (REQUIRES 20260619140000): forged actor -> ACTOR_MISMATCH (G3); a job with application_service_id gets ONE is_application_fee line (price_source 'tier') + the service FK on the invoice; a FLAT/unrated chemical line still bills; per-customer fee rate in split jobs (a grower's customer_application_rates override is honored — Codex P1); totals + shares reconcile in single / same-rate-split / different-rate-split cases. Pre-apply the chain FAILS (live body has no fee line). NOTE: the prior full start_job->complete->post->void loop chain file is absent; this chain certifies transfer_job_to_invoice's fee+actor behavior.

transfer_invoice_to_job.description: #27 reverse leg (REQUIRES 20260625120000): full job<->invoice round-trip. transfer_job_to_invoice creates the unposted invoice (job invoiced + invoice_id set + per-customer shares + application_records linked), then transfer_invoice_to_job reverses it (invoice -> cancelled, items+shares deleted, application_records.invoice_id cleared, job invoiced -> completed, jobs.invoice_id NULL, one invoice_cancelled audit row). Proves: forged actor -> ACTOR_MISMATCH (no mutation); idempotent replay (same key -> saved result, no 2nd audit row); the returned job re-transfers to a NEW invoice; a POSTED invoice is refused ('Only a draft or unposted invoice...'); an engine-built field invoice with no job_id is refused.

unpost_invoice.description: #28 unpost leg (REQUIRES 20260625130000): post->unpost round-trip on a field_application invoice. post_invoice posts a draft (posted_by/at stamped, invoice_posted audit row); unpost_invoice reverses it (posted|overdue -> unposted, posted_by/at cleared, money fields untouched, one append-only invoice_unposted audit row, post row preserved). Proves: forged actor -> ACTOR_MISMATCH (no mutation); idempotent replay (same key -> saved result, no 2nd audit row); re-post after unpost works; MONEY GUARD refuses a posted invoice with an allocated payment + paid_amount_cents (status unchanged, allocation intact, no audit row); STATUS GUARD refuses a never-posted draft ('nothing to unpost'); PERIOD GUARD refuses a posted invoice in a CLOSED accounting period (status unchanged); an 'overdue' invoice unposts (superset of posted).

dispatch_job_locations.description: Field-app parity #36 (REQUIRES 20260626120000): per-location dispatch wizard commit. Proves through the REAL dispatch_job_locations RPC + the new job_location_dispatches table: MULTI-APPLICATOR SPLIT (location A->applicator 1 and location B->applicator 2 in one call -> {dispatched:2}, two rows with DIFFERENT applicators); IDEMPOTENCY (same key -> same result, no new rows); RE-DISPATCH UPSERT (re-dispatching a location to a crew REPLACES its row in place, never duplicates); XOR GUARD (both-assignee and neither-assignee both raise ONE_ASSIGNEE_REQUIRED); ROLE GATE (an applicator caller -> INSUFFICIENT_ROLE); ACTOR GATE (forged p_performed_by -> ACTOR_MISMATCH); LIFECYCLE GATE (a location on a cancelled job -> JOB_NOT_DISPATCHABLE); RLS READ (the dispatched applicator can SELECT their own row though not the whole-job applicator); RLS WRITE — RPC-ONLY (neither an applicator NOR an admin can directly INSERT; the SECURITY DEFINER RPC is the sole write path); LICENSE GATE (an applicator with an all-expired active license -> LICENSE_EXPIRED, admin p_license_override succeeds); CREW-MEMBER RLS READ (a member of the dispatched crew can read the crew dispatch row AND the parent job AND its job_fields); PER-LOCATION-APPLICATOR JOB READ (a per-location-only assignee can read the parent job via jobs_select_location_dispatchee — the recursion-safe _is_dispatched_to_me helper breaks the jobs<->dispatches policy cycle); CANCELLED-DISPATCH VISIBILITY REVOKE (a cancelled dispatch no longer surfaces the row/job/fields to the former assignee); LICENSE-OVERRIDE AUDIT (an actual override writes a job_location_dispatched activity_feed row + returns license_overrides count); FK CASCADE (deleting an assignee cascades the dispatch row, never failing the XOR check); CUSTOMER RLS READ (a per-location assignee can read the job's embedded customer); SOFT-DELETED JOB rejected (the RLS-bypassing RPC requires deleted_at IS NULL → JOB_NOT_FOUND); ACTIVITY LOG (every normal dispatch — not just overrides — writes a job_location_dispatched activity_feed row, restoring the audit trail); DEACTIVATED ASSIGNEE LOSES VISIBILITY (the is_active re-check in _is_dispatched_to_me + the SELECT policy revokes a deactivated user's dispatch/job read even with a live token). Self-contained fixtures.

undispatch_job_locations.description: Field-app parity #37 (REQUIRES 20260626120000 + 20260626140000): Dispatched List + reassign/undispatch. Proves through the REAL undispatch_job_locations + get_dispatched_list RPCs (+ dispatch_job_locations for reassign): SETUP/LIST (dispatch loc A->app1, loc B->app2; get_dispatched_list returns both rows fully shaped — assignee name resolved server-side, job#, field name, status, location + job acres); ASSIGNEE FILTER (get_dispatched_list(app1) returns only loc A); REASSIGN (dispatch_job_locations re-dispatches loc A->app2 as an upsert; the list shows loc A under app2, no duplicate, no longer under app1); UNDISPATCH (undispatch_job_locations([loc B]) -> {undispatched:1}, the row's dispatch_status='cancelled', the list drops loc B, an activity_feed audit row is written); UNDISPATCH REVOKES VISIBILITY (the former assignee can no longer SELECT the cancelled dispatch row); ROLE GATE (an applicator caller -> INSUFFICIENT_ROLE); ACTOR GATE (forged p_performed_by -> ACTOR_MISMATCH); IDEMPOTENCY (replaying the same undispatch key -> same result, cancels nothing new); NO-OP UNDISPATCH (undispatching a never-dispatched location -> {undispatched:0}, not an error); ANON DENIED (anon has no EXECUTE on either new fn). Self-contained fixtures.

unpost_invoice_group.description: Field-app remediation Wave 2a FIX 4 (REQUIRES 20260629170000): ALL-OR-NOTHING split-group unpost. Proves through the REAL unpost_invoice_group: HAPPY (a posted 2-member split group unposts in ONE call — both members posted->unposted, posted_by/at cleared, one invoice_unposted audit row per member, one invoice_group_unposted activity row); ALL-OR-NOTHING (a posted group where one member is PAID/money-applied -> the whole call RAISES the money-guard error and NOTHING changes — both still posted, 0 unpost audit rows; no half-unpost reachable); ROLE GATE (an applicator caller -> 'admin or sales role required'); ACTOR GATE (forged p_performed_by -> ACTOR_MISMATCH, no mutation); GRANTS (anon has NO EXECUTE, authenticated does). Self-contained fixtures.

get_jobs_billed_customers.description: Field-app remediation Wave 2a FIX 2 (REQUIRES 20260629160000): batched, RLS-safe billed-customer resolver for the jobs list. Proves through the REAL get_jobs_billed_customers vs get_job_billed_customers: PARITY (as an applicator on a split job, the batch resolver returns the SAME customer_id set as the per-job resolver — exactly {primary A, co-billed B}); CO-BILLED VISIBLE (the co-billed split owner B IS returned to the applicator, the bug being that the job_field_shares.customer RLS embed dropped B; exactly one is_primary row); GRANTS (anon has NO EXECUTE, authenticated does). Self-contained fixtures.

job_applied_record_fields_rls.description: Field-app remediation Wave 2a FIX 1 (REQUIRES 20260629150000): field-membership RLS on job_applied_record_fields INSERT/UPDATE. Proves with a sales_rep under RLS (role authenticated): REJECT (inserting a row whose field_id is NOT one of the parent record's job fields fails the WITH CHECK — row-level security violation); ACCEPT (an in-job field_id inserts cleanly, exactly one row, no foreign row); UPDATE REJECT (moving the legit row's field_id onto a foreign field fails the WITH CHECK; the row stays on the in-job field). Self-contained fixtures. (Policy-only migration; no callable RPC — the covers token below is the TABLE name so `--spec job_applied_record_fields` resolves this chain.)

enforce_billed_job_immutability.description: Field-app parity #12 + P1 remediation (REQUIRES 20260625190000 & 20260629120000): regression guard for the _enforce_billed_job_immutability BEFORE-UPDATE trigger on jobs. Proves with a sales_rep under RLS (role authenticated) on an INVOICED job: BLOCKED — soft-delete (deleted_at NULL->non-NULL) RAISES 'cannot be deleted by a non-admin'; rewrite total_price_cents RAISES 'cannot edit its billed-relevant fields'; rewrite invoice_id->NULL (detach) and invoice_id->other (repoint) BOTH RAISE the same (the P1 remediation closing the invoice_id hole); and a sanity check that no blocked path leaked a mutation. EXEMPT — printed_at/last_printed_by (print audit), applied_acres (as-applied recompute), updated_at/updated_by (bookkeeping) all SUCCEED for the non-admin. HATCH — an ADMIN (jwt sub=admin, is_admin()=true) CAN correct total_price_cents; the app.admin_override='true' definer-flow hatch lets an otherwise-blocked non-admin write through. LEGIT WRITERS — transfer_job_to_invoice (writes jobs.invoice_id while status='completed', guard early-returns) and transfer_invoice_to_job (clears invoice_id under the override hatch) both still succeed. Self-contained fixtures; ends in SMOKE_PASS_ROLLBACK. (Trigger-only migration; the covers token is the trigger/function name so `--spec enforce_billed_job_immutability` resolves this chain.)

save_field_app_split_invoice.description: Per-line split-billing engine full chain: flag gate raises when disabled; a manual-rate service line plus an odd-cents manual chemical line across a 50/50 two-owner field produce penny-exact largest-remainder children (5751/5750 of 11501c) whose stored invoice_line_shares/invoice_items/invoice_shares all tie; identical replay with the same idempotency key returns the same invoice ids; compute_line_split_allocation splits 100c three ways as {34,33,33}; and the duplicate-product, off-job-field, job-immutability, and non-admin resolver-auth guards each raise for real. G5 regression probe (runs first, cold plan): a save with no service line must succeed (pre-fix unassigned-v_app_service crash, fixed live 2026-07-21 by migration 20260721180000). Self-contained [E2E] fixtures and terminal rollback.

commission_payout_intent_binding_live.description: LIVE-RUNNABLE counterpart to the CONTAINER ONLY create_commission_payment chain above: it seeds its own [SMOKE] customer/order/commissions, needs no prover fixtures and no public.proof_effects, so it can be executed against the live database on demand (as postgres/service_role, after 20260811130000 is applied). This is the chain that actually certified the intent binding against production on 2026-08-11 - terminal text SMOKE_PASS_ROLLBACK (9/9 incl. cross-actor). Proves that a real payout's receipt carries request_actor_id plus a 64-character request_fingerprint; that an identical intent replays to the SAME payment id and the fingerprint ignores surrounding whitespace; that a changed commission selection or a changed reference on the retained key raises IDEMPOTENCY_INTENT_MISMATCH; that a NULL key raises IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED and pays nothing; that a pre-migration receipt with both binding columns NULL fails closed instead of replaying; that post_commission_payment replays correctly while the same key aimed at a DIFFERENT payment raises IDEMPOTENCY_INTENT_MISMATCH and leaves that payment unposted; and that a second active admin reusing the first admin's key gets IDEMPOTENCY_ACTOR_MISMATCH. On a database with only one active admin the chain ends at 8/8 and says so - still a PASS, but the cross-actor case went unproven. Keep both chains: the container one covers more cases (void, blank keys, cross-operation reuse, the unchanged guard surface), this one is the part that can be re-run live.

create_commission_payment.description: CONTAINER ONLY - run via scripts/smoke/prove-commission-payout-intent-binding.mjs, never through run-smoke.mjs against the live database: the chain reads the disposable public.proof_effects table and the synthetic commission/profile ids that only the prover plants, so against live it dies on a missing relation instead of SMOKE_PASS_ROLLBACK. Section 07 gauntlet finding 2 (REQUIRES 20260811130000): the three commission payout RPCs keyed idempotency receipts on (idempotency_key, operation) only — the browser-generated key text embedded a user id, but the server never read, stored or validated it — so a retained browser key could replay a DIFFERENT payout's cached success. Proves per RPC that an exact retry replays the committed receipt once (create: order-swapped and duplicated commission id arrays still replay; void: a whitespace-variant reason still replays) and that the receipt carries request_actor_id plus request_fingerprint; that a changed intent is REJECTED with IDEMPOTENCY_INTENT_MISMATCH and performs no work (create: changed commission selection, changed notes, changed payment method; post: a different payment id; void: a different payment id or a changed reason); that a second admin reusing the same key gets IDEMPOTENCY_ACTOR_MISMATCH; that a pre-migration receipt carrying neither binding column fails closed instead of replaying; that cross-operation key reuse still raises; and that a NULL or blank key is REFUSED with IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED on all three RPCs and the refused call performs no work — the reverse of the pre-migration behaviour, where an omitted key did the work unreceipted. Also re-proves the unchanged guard surface — blank void reason, forged p_performed_by, non-admin on all three, and unauthenticated. prove-commission-payout-intent-binding.mjs runs the same chain against a network-isolated disposable PostgreSQL container, planting the fixtures the chain assumes. Ends in SMOKE_PASS_ROLLBACK.

restore_quote_version_trust_boundary.description: Rollback-only runtime proof for 20260826220000: an owner-created unmarked legacy version must raise the exact QUOTE_VERSION_LEGACY_UNTRUSTED error and leave quote/header/section/item state unchanged, while a newly RPC-created marked version restores successfully with the authoritative N+1 row-version token. The standing quote-versions-rpc-owned predicate separately pins that rejection before the sole owner-side restore call. EXPECT SMOKE_PREREQ until the trust-boundary migration is deployed.

allocated_line_cents.description: CONTAINER ONLY - run via scripts/smoke/prove-allocated-line-cents.mjs, never through run-smoke.mjs against the live database: the chain INSERTs orders, deliveries and invoices, which the LIVE-DATA GUARD correctly refuses, and it depends on the disposable scaffolding in fixtures/allocated-line-cents-base.sql. CRX-MONEY-LIFECYCLE-001 (fixed by 20260817120000): the tier-split draw-down deliberately makes an order line total_price differ from ROUND(price_per_unit * quantity, 2) - a drawn line carries the tier cumulative rounded value minus cents already committed - but delivery invoicing, the backfill invoicing path and Cancel Remaining each threw that allocation away and re-derived money by multiplying unit price by quantity again, so every fractional segment rounded independently and the total drifted from the booking (order says 25c, invoice bills 26c). Six scenarios: two draws off one booking both delivered; one line delivered as two deliveries; deliver-then-Cancel-Remaining; the backfill invoicing path; three fractional draws telescoping 4+3+4 to exactly 11c; and a voided invoice that must not consume allocation. The prover plants the three lifecycle bodies sliced byte-exact from their migration files (md5-pinned to the 2026-08-17 production snapshot, including the CRLF storage form of _close_undelivered_order_remainder_20260718 so the migration md5 preconditions are exercised for real), runs the chain against the PRE-FIX bodies and requires all six scenarios to report ALLOCATION_DRIFT, applies the migration verbatim in one transaction, then requires the same chain to reach SMOKE_PASS_ROLLBACK. A chain that passes pre-fix aborts the proof. Ends in SMOKE_PASS_ROLLBACK.
